description: Capability for the sniffer top-level WebviewWindow (label 'browser-sniffer', see SNIFFER_WEBVIEW_LABEL). Grants only the event bus (the bootstrap emits/listens BrowserSnifferBridge traffic on the multiplexed BRIDGE_EVENT channel) and log access; core:default is deliberately withheld because the loaded third-party page shares the bootstrap's JS context. `remote.urls` is required: the sniffer navigates to arbitrary external http(s):// URLs (Origin::Remote), and without a matching urlpattern every IPC call is rejected as `not allowed on window`. The pattern is permissive because the target EHR / health-portal hosts can't be enumerated ahead of time. Security: the threat model assumes the loaded page may be adversarial — anything the bootstrap can do, the page can too. The Owner bearer is NOT reachable here: gatekeeper_current_token is gated by allow-gatekeeper-current-token, which this capability does not grant.
